parameters.query:
SELECT
    existing.id IS NOT NULL AS submission_exists,
    existing.id AS existing_record_id,
    existing.correlation_id AS existing_correlation_id,
    existing.payload_hash AS existing_payload_hash,
    existing.processing_status AS existing_processing_status
FROM (VALUES (1)) AS seed(value)
LEFT JOIN lead_crm.lead_submissions AS existing
    ON existing.submission_id = $1::uuid;

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.lead_submissions (
        submission_id,
        correlation_id,
        source,
        submitted_at,
        email_normalized,
        message,
        consent,
        raw_payload,
        normalized_payload,
        payload_hash,
        processing_status,
        validation_errors
    )
    VALUES (
        $1::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        $3,
        $4::timestamptz,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7::boolean,
        $8::jsonb,
        $9::jsonb,
        $10,
        $11,
        $12::jsonb
    )
    ON CONFLICT (submission_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING
        id,
        submission_id,
        payload_hash,
        processing_status,
        created_at
),
created_audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id,
        submission_id,
        event_type,
        actor_type,
        from_status,
        to_status,
        event_data
    )
    SELECT
        $2::uuid,
        inserted.id,
        CASE
            WHEN $11 = 'INVALID' THEN 'LEAD_REJECTED'
            ELSE 'LEAD_ACCEPTED'
        END,
        'WORKFLOW',
        'VALIDATING',
        $11,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'payload_hash', $10,
            'validation_errors', $12::jsonb
        )
    FROM inserted
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    true AS record_created,
    inserted.id AS submission_record_id,
    inserted.submission_id,
    inserted.payload_hash AS stored_payload_hash,
    inserted.processing_status,
    inserted.created_at,
    (SELECT id FROM created_audit) AS audit_event_id
FROM inserted

UNION ALL

SELECT
    false AS record_created,
    existing.id AS submission_record_id,
    existing.submission_id,
    existing.payload_hash AS stored_payload_hash,
    existing.processing_status,
    existing.created_at,
    NULL::bigint AS audit_event_id
FROM lead_crm.lead_submissions AS existing
WHERE existing.submission_id = $1::uuid
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)

LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
    correlation_id,
    submission_id,
    event_type,
    actor_type,
    from_status,
    to_status,
    event_data
)
VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    NULL,
    'INVALID_SUBMISSION_ID',
    'WORKFLOW',
    'VALIDATING',
    'INVALID',
    jsonb_build_object(
        'provided_submission_id', $2,
        'validation_errors', $3::jsonb,
        'raw_payload', $4::jsonb
    )
)
RETURNING
    id AS audit_event_id,
    'INVALID_SUBMISSION_ID' AS outcome,
    $2 AS submission_id,
    $1::uuid AS correlation_id,
    'INVALID' AS processing_status,
    $3::jsonb AS validation_errors,
    false AS record_created,
    false AS should_continue;

WITH audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id,
        submission_id,
        event_type,
        actor_type,
        from_status,
        to_status,
        event_data
    )
    VALUES (
        $6::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        'IDEMPOTENT_REPEAT',
        'WORKFLOW',
        $4,
        $4,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'original_correlation_id', $3::uuid,
            'payload_hash', $5
        )
    )
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    $1 AS submission_id,
    $2::uuid AS existing_record_id,
    $3::uuid AS existing_correlation_id,
    $4 AS existing_processing_status,
    $5 AS existing_payload_hash,
    audit.id AS audit_event_id
FROM audit;

WITH updated AS (
    UPDATE lead_crm.lead_submissions
    SET
        processing_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
    RETURNING
        id,
        submission_id,
        correlation_id,
        processing_status
),
audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id,
        submission_id,
        event_type,
        actor_type,
        from_status,
        to_status,
        event_data
    )
    SELECT
        $3::uuid,
        updated.id,
        'SUBMISSION_ID_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT',
        'WORKFLOW',
        $2,
        'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'original_correlation_id', updated.correlation_id,
            'stored_payload_hash', $4,
            'attempted_payload_hash', $5,
            'attempted_raw_payload', $6::jsonb,
            'attempted_normalized_payload', $7::jsonb
        )
    FROM updated
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    'SUBMISSION_ID_CONFLICT' AS outcome,
    updated.submission_id,
    updated.id AS submission_record_id,
    updated.correlation_id AS original_correlation_id,
    $3::uuid AS attempted_correlation_id,
    updated.processing_status,
    false AS record_created,
    false AS should_continue,
    audit.id AS audit_event_id
FROM updated
CROSS JOIN audit;
